name: Gujarat State Data Centre - Rajkot mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Rajkot (also Surat, Vadodara, Mahesana); GIL/GSDC page confirms GSDC program but not the Rajkot node. No commercial colo evidence found for Rajkot district. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Gujarat State Data Centre - Surat mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Surat. No commercial/hyperscale project found for Surat district despite searches (DCD notes Gujarat DCs concentrated in Ahmedabad/GIFT City, outside this district). Capacity not disclosed.

name: Gujarat State Data Centre - Vadodara mini/colocation node
notes: Government state-data-centre node. Academic paper (IJCSEITR, Dec 2019) states GSDC provides mini/colocation data centre at Vadodara. No commercial/hyperscale project found for Vadodara district; Gujarat DC activity (Yotta G1, CtrlS Gandhinagar 1, Reliance Jamnagar, Dholera AI DC) sits in other districts. Capacity not disclosed.

name: BSNL - Dimension Data Faridabad Datacenter Phase I
notes: Uptime Institute certification record lists 'BSNL - Dimension Data, Faridabad, Haryana India, Project: Faridabad Datacenter Phase I' - primary certification record for facility existence/design. Capacity not stated in record. datacenters.com lists 8 data centers in Haryana state (aggregator, C-grade context).

name: Nxtra by Airtel - Manesar hyperscale data centre (NCR 3)
notes: Official Nxtra page lists Manesar (NCR 3) among 15 hyperscale DCs across 8 major markets (230+ MW total power across hyperscale portfolio; per-facility MW not published). Manesar is in Gurugram district, Haryana.

name: Anant Raj Cloud - Manesar data centre
notes: TOI (25 Jul 2025): Anant Raj scaled Manesar centre from 6 MW to 21 MW IT load; first Manesar DC commissioned Sep 2023. Part of 28 MW operational across Manesar+Panchkula; company targets 310 MW portfolio by 2032 (TOI).

name: PowerGrid Corporation of India - Manesar data centre
notes: DCD (17 Jul 2023): PGCIL planned data centre in Manesar (Gurugram district) outside Delhi. Capacity and current status not published; treat as announced/construction until further evidence.
